localEquivalence.result: the provider exists but has no transcription path; the generic multipart branch does not match the wire envelope, so this module is the whole delta

exports.openrouterSttAdapter: default STT adapter instance; transcribe({ model, formData, credentials, kind, signal })
exports.createOpenRouterSttAdapter: factory; options { fetchImpl, timeoutMs, maxTranscriptBytes } for tests
exports.buildOpenRouterTranscriptionRequest: async (model, formData, { kind }) -> { body, responseFormat } or a 400 error result with local: true
exports.resolveOpenRouterAudioFormat: (file, bytes?) -> input_audio.format or null (source rule, byte check instead of the wav fallback)
exports.sniffOpenRouterAudioFormat: (bytes) -> container from leading bytes or null
exports.openrouterSttRefusal: (status, { secrets, retryAfter }) refusal mapping that never quotes the upstream
exports.OPENROUTER_STT_CONFIG: staged sttConfig for the existing openrouter registry entry

provider.attributionHeaders: none: the source STT request sends only Authorization and Content-Type, unlike the registry's HTTP-Referer / X-Title on other OpenRouter configs

models.passthrough: refused: the registry's passthroughModels covers chat; transcription takes only the listed ids
models.dynamicDiscovery: none: the source lists OpenRouter transcription models statically; the registry's modelsFetcher (https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models, type openrouter-free) feeds chat models and is not an STT contract

transcription.body: { model, input_audio: { data: <base64>, format }, language?, response_format?, temperature? (number), timestamp_granularities? (array) }
transcription.answer: json / verbose_json object with string text (usage and duration kept), or text/plain
